prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival, I observed two vehicles at the intersection with heavy front-end damage to the passenger side of the eastbound sedan and the front bumper area of the westbound pickup. Traffic was flowing normally and the signal was operating. Driver 1, operating the westbound pickup, stated that the vehicle ahead of them was turning left across their path and that they could not stop in time. Driver 2, operating the eastbound sedan, stated they had a green light and were proceeding straight when the pickup entered the intersection. A passenger in the sedan, identified here only as Passenger, remained at the scene and was not observed to be injured. Driver 2 reported pain in the right shoulder and declined transport at the scene. Both vehicles were driven from the scene after exchange of information. Witness statements were not obtained at the time of the report. Citation pending review of the signal timing and vehicle positions.
